verdict: REJECT RELEASE; NO_GO NOT YET PROVEN. Candidate 97cb155 contains the first valid strict production-path GLM timing arm: 160 raw token IDs/timestamps, 1.232906 tok/s decode, 52.9558 s TTFT, 1.15190 tok/s prefill, 88.1978 GiB minimum available memory, and no OOM/Xid. The diagnostic gap to the standalone DeepSeek arm is enormous and makes a bounded physical-NO_GO campaign higher value than further broad optimization. It still cannot authorize NO_GO because the arms are one-block, unequal-fixture and asymmetrically instrumented, while the GLM engine is broad and not reference-qualified. The minimal path is a focused correctness gate, one exact five-block matched campaign, and an optimistic physical upper-throughput scorer that still fails after granting optimal caching, perfect overlap, the best quality-passing representation, and maximal bounded MTP benefit. Until those pass and both persistent reviews independently verify the bound, DeepSeek V4 Flash must remain the default.
